Description
Welcome to 2 Burrard Place! Brand-new 2 bed, 2 bath corner residence on the 33rd floor with northeast city and mountain views. Floor-to-ceiling indows, wide-plank hardwood, A/C, private balcony, Italian kitchen with Gaggenau appliances, integrated cabinetry and stone island. Spa-inspired bathrooms feature heated floors and Cielo fixtures. Upgrades include motorized blinds and integrated lighting controls. Enjoy 30,000 sq. ft. of Club One amenities with pool, fitness, wellness and 24/7 concierge. Steps o Yaletown, False Creek, seawall, dining, shopping and transit. Unfurnished, available now. 1 parking, 1 storage, dedicated bike lock. 1-year minimum. Pets negotiable. Tenant insurance required.
